title: Files panel: browse the focused terminal's folder, preview text files, and open or copy any file
story: The icon strip gains a Files icon right after History, with no keyboard shortcut. It opens a panel showing the folder of the terminal you last clicked: its worktree if it has one, otherwise its project. You can browse folders one level at a time, preview text files read-only, and open or copy any file or folder; reopening a folder reads it again. Before this, Maestro had no file browser; nothing was removed.

checks.criterion: With no terminal open, the panel says so
checks.steps: Open a project with no terminals, then click the Files icon (second in the strip, after History).
checks.expected: 'Showing files of' and 'No terminal open. Start or click a terminal to see its folder.', with no tree.

checks.criterion: The panel shows the focused terminal's worktree, else its project folder
checks.steps: Open a made-up project demo-shop, start one terminal in a worktree and one without, open Files, then click each terminal in turn.
checks.expected: The worktree terminal shows a green WORKTREE chip and the worktree path; the other a grey PROJECT chip and the project path; the tree changes with each click and the copy button copies the shown path.

checks.criterion: Folders load when opened, reload when reopened, and git-ignored entries show dimmed
checks.steps: In a project with node_modules/ and .env in .gitignore, open Files, click node_modules, then src. Create a new file in src outside Maestro, then close and reopen src.
checks.expected: .env and node_modules are listed but dimmed; a folder opens one level, a second click closes it; after reopening src the new file appears and the old entries stay on screen until it does.

checks.criterion: Text files up to about 1 MB preview read-only; bigger or binary files show Can't preview with the reason
checks.steps: Click README.md, then a .png file, then a text file over 1 MB.
checks.expected: README's text below the tree with its path, a READ-ONLY mark and copy, open and close buttons; the PNG shows 'Can't preview' and 'This is not a text file.'; the big file shows 'This file is N MB. Preview shows text files up to about 1 MB.'; both offer 'Open in default app'.

checks.criterion: Double-click, hover buttons and right-click menu open or copy the full path
checks.steps: Double-click a file. Hover a file and click each of its two buttons, then double-click the copy button. Right-click a file, then a folder.
checks.expected: The file opens in its default app and a folder in the file manager; 'Copied <full path>' shows under the tree; double-clicking the copy button does not open the file; the file menu offers Preview, Open in default app and Copy full path; the folder menu Copy full path and Open in default app.
